== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later English Errata articles for [[Undercover (Dark)]]. Columns are Original and Decipher Errata only (Supplement and Appendix A match Glossary 2.0). [[Undercover (Dark) (PC Errata)]] redirects to [[Undercover (Dark) (Errata)]]. Do not transclude onto Light [[Undercover]]. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
